title: peltophorus forficulatus var. hirsuta
intro: Peltophorus forficulatus var. hirsuta, commonly known as the 'Wild Pear', is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Peltophorus forficulatus var. hirsuta include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
